p.b: Q: I'm getting confused with terms like toolbox, tooltip, dataZoom, series… Where do I start?

html.p: Check out the ECharts Cheat Sheet. It's a good map of the terminology. Then work through Tutorial 1 and Tutorial 2 for hands-on basics.

p.b: Q: What dataType options are available?

html.p: Four modes are supported via the visualization_toolbox.hman.dataType option:

tr.td: Full Apache ECharts option object — any chart type ECharts supports. See Tutorials 1–8.
One SPL row per box (name, lower, Q1, median, Q3, upper, outliers). See Tutorial 9.
Multi-series grouped boxplots via a transposed 8-row table. See Tutorial 10.
Gantt-style chart with automatic axis/legend construction. See Tutorial 11.

p.b: Q: The visualization fails with "Error rendering Visualization Toolbox visualization".

html.p: For Custom mode: paste your option string into the ECharts example editor to catch syntax errors first. Then check your seriesDataIndexBinding and xAxisDataIndexBinding values against the column indices your search actually returns.
For SimpleBoxplot: confirm the search returns exactly 6 or 7 columns in the correct order, and that the option string defines at least xAxis: {}.
For Boxplot: confirm the search returns exactly 8 rows after | sort seq. Row 7 must contain the number of unique category values — if this is wrong the builder will misgroup the boxes.
For Timeline: confirm columns 0 and 1 are Unix timestamps in seconds (not milliseconds). now() and relative_time() return seconds; multiply by 1000 if your source already provides milliseconds.

p.b: Q: My SimpleBoxplot shows phantom scatter points at y=0.

html.p: The outlier column (index 6) contains an empty string "" instead of a true null. Use | eval outliers=null() for rows that have no outliers. An empty string passes the null-check in the builder and gets parsed as 0.

p.b: Q: My multi-series Boxplot renders in the wrong order or boxes are missing.

html.p: Add | eval seq=N to each sub-search and | sort seq before the final | table. Multiple | makeresults sub-searches share the same _time, so Splunk's row ordering is non-deterministic without an explicit sort key.

p.b: Q: Timeline splitByHour shows no data or a blank chart.

html.p: timeline_splitByHour=true requires the dashboard to be a <form> with a time picker whose token is exactly time_range. The builder reads the time_range.earliest and time_range.latest tokens from the Splunk token model to build the hourly y-axis — any other token name is ignored and the chart renders blank. The search element must also include <earliest>$time_range.earliest$</earliest> and <latest>$time_range.latest$</latest>. Also confirm the time range is 24 hours or less.

p.b: Q: Does visualization toolbox support Dashboard Studio?

html.p: No. Dashboard Studio does not support custom visualizations, so the visualization toolbox is not available there.

p.b: Q: Does visualization toolbox support Splunk Mobile?

html.p: No. The Splunk Mobile app does not support custom visualizations.

p.b: Q: Is visualization toolbox running on Splunk Cloud?

html.p: Yes, it has been tested on Splunk Cloud. If you find any issues please report them via the GitHub issue tracker.

p.b: Q: I need a specific feature in my chart. How do I configure it?

html.p: Use the ECharts example editor to build and test your option object, then copy it into the visualization_toolbox.hman.option field. The ECharts option reference documents every property.

p.b: Q: I want to use visualization toolbox in a business-critical app. Is support available?

html.p: The app is free to use. Community support is available via the GitHub issue tracker. For paid support, consulting, or training contact us at visualization_toolbox@web.de.
